description: Source code for the LiveDataSource class, part of Android's media framework, handling live data streaming with buffer management, including reading, queuing, and resetting buffers.

classes.name: LiveDataSource
classes.description: A class managing live media data buffers, supporting reading, queuing, and resetting data streams.

methods.name: LiveDataSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer queue, offset, and final result; optionally opens backup file.

methods.name: ~LiveDataSource
methods.description: Destructor closing backup file if open.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks initialization status, always returns OK.

methods.name: countQueuedBuffers
methods.description: Returns the number of buffers currently queued.

methods.name: readAtNonBlocking
methods.description: Reads data non-blockingly if offset matches current offset, returns buffer data or error.

methods.name: readAt
methods.description: Reads data at specified offset, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: readAt_l
methods.description: Internal method to perform actual read at offset, handling buffer management.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Adds a buffer to the queue, optionally saving to backup file.

methods.name: queueEOS
methods.description: Marks end of stream with final result, notifying waiting threads.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer queue and final result, clearing state.
